figure_contract.scope: Initial physical controls; full load-model and deformable-grasp acceptance remains pending

figure_contract.controls_claim: Scalar peak convergence can precede full tensor convergence; contact regularization changes force
controls_panels: Shell peak, energy and full-tensor probe errors
figure_contract.slice_claim: Matched physical stress sampling with identical colour limits retains visible spatial differences
figure_contract.slice_sampling: Exact per-element linear stress at tetrahedral centroids in fixed |y|<0.6mm slab; no cross-element smoothing
figure_contract.peak_marker: Projected location of the full3D unaveraged corner maximum; may lie outside the displayed slab

captions.controls: Full3D independent scikit-fem P2 shell versus Lamé, and supported deformable-block IPC controls. Dashed lines show the initially declared3% target. Red crosses at the activation-distance axis mark failed solves with no accepted error value. Contact force/peak errors use0.5N/5000Pa analytic zero-gap values.
captions.slice: Common centroid samples within |y|<0.6mm at h=0.08; units and colour limits match. The raw full3D global corner peak is21.718kPa, versus21.316kPa analytic. The open star projects its location; slice colours do not replace that unsmoothed maximum.

figure_contract.alt_text: Three convergence curves compare independent shell and contact errors. A paired shell slice compares analytic and FEM von Mises stress with the same colour scale and a marked projection of the global raw FEM hotspot.

limitations: This checkpoint qualifies reference algebra/gauge and initial physical controls only. Contact-reference regressions and unresolved fine configurations remain failed. Solver-scaling trials are excluded. Full shapes, four load models, friction and egg/interior-hotspot deformable contact remain required.
